body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #1, company drawn at random (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.63 (naive base rate 0.42) that: Sunflag Iron & Steel FY27 consolidated revenue from operations is >= Rs 4,300 cr. Our reasoning: H1 FY27 Rs 2,201 cr (+10.3% YoY; Q2 +15%); needs H2 >= Rs 2,099 cr (+8.0% vs H2 FY26 Rs 1,943 cr), against a soft Q3 FY26 base (Rs 942 cr) and volumes growing ~4%/yr. Naive base: share of Sunflag's own last 12 fiscal years with revenue growth >= 9.2% (5 of 12: FY15, FY18, FY22, FY23, FY26) [SCR]. Resolution: YES if consolidated revenue from operations for FY27 (1-Apr-2026 to 31-Mar-2027), as first reported in the audited FY27 results, is >= Rs 4,300 cr (NSE integrated-filing XBRL and screener.in agree; standalone only if no consolidated filing). Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL (FY27 results) + screener.in consolidated. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate to test whether deep-dive probabilities beat naive base rates.
